frozen_proposal.action: complete three-axis proposal, after production gain bounds

calibration.sampling: Fresh independent plant cohort for each stage, under frozen earlier thresholds; only reached changed proposals enter that stage calibration.
calibration.insufficient_sample: q=1 (bounded-score infinity equivalent); both labels; hold
calibration.model_temperature: Reuse frozen v1 model and temperature; no fitting or outcome-based selection.

scope.candidate: complete bounded Temp Only vector, expectation=true, shrinkage=1
scope.risk_rejection: stop without operating simulation; optional diagnostic cannot affect state or best
scope.safety_veto: stop on the existing divergence/cost safety predicate; no recovery or rollback actions
scope.return: best actually executed measurement including initial gains

harm_definitions.harmful_gt_2pct: J_after > 1.02*J_before; explicitly named legacy secondary metric
harm_definitions.trajectory_event: at least one actually executed changed proposal is harmful
harm_definitions.coverage_denominator: reached changed proposals with measured labels, including rejected diagnostics; never padded stops

accounting.total: operating + diagnostic; all real plant-runs counted once
accounting.reuse: no repeated identical parameter simulation in deterministic rollout

acceptance.first_stage_denominator: all 1024 test plants, including pre-proposal stops
acceptance.interpretation: Separate one-sided 95% binomial bounds; mean/p90 are empirical engineering gates, not population noninferiority theorems.
acceptance.failure: remain research-only; no alpha, threshold or model adjustment from test outcomes
